status: All twelve round-two audit findings implemented; full local macOS regression suite passed.

initial.cause: New inspector volume automation button remained enabled on a locked track.

focused_history.repair: Inspector controls now disable on locked tracks.

coverage: Locked crossfade mutation commands and undo; inspector numeric actions and locked controls.
Placement on track 65, invalid/nonfinite/out-of-range timeline placement, valid save afterward.
Waiting for source verification, cancellation, and document replacement before import completion.
Sequential batch cancellation, keeping accepted media, duplicate detection, and missing-source rejection.
Accepted relinks clear stale source-verification flags.
Native export of 160 sequential clips bounds open descriptors and preserves decoded samples.
Clip volume, clip pan, and track volume graph/numeric editor controls and locked state.
Asynchronous save ordering, undo, corrective save, new edits during initial save, rebased media references, write failure, switched documents, and queued initial saves.
Saved-project autosave and disabled preference; unsaved documents still require a destination.
Cache byte counts exclude symlinks; appearance controls apply system/light/dark immediately.
Existing portable video/audio collection, relinking, renderer, compressed export, recovery, localization, and editing regression coverage.

workflow_changes.autosave: Enabled by default for projects with a save location, debounced by 0.8 seconds; can be disabled in Preferences. Crash recovery remains separate.
workflow_changes.rename: Project menu renames the current project without making a copy.
workflow_changes.imports: Folder and batch imports are cancellable; completed imports are retained.
workflow_changes.preferences: Immediate appearance selection and separate waveform/proxy/recovery cache usage.

limitations: Tests ran locally on macOS; no iPad device or Simulator run was performed for these fixes.
AppKit controls were exercised in process; this is not a complete manual accessibility or visual audit.
Cache sizes are snapshots and can change as background jobs finish.
Historical audit.json and baseline probe results describe the pre-fix source and are retained unchanged.
ipad_checkout: Not modified. Pre-existing working-tree status matches the pre-run record.
